_comment: Editable topic-search queries for news_fetch.py. Each string is a Google News RSS search — the engine actively pulls matching articles (bodies included) so the classifiers get the evidence they need, not just whatever the fixed market feeds carry. Add/remove freely; no code change needed. Set NEWSAGENT_SEARCH=0 to disable search entirely.
_comment_oil_geo: OIL & MIDDLE-EAST block: the NewsAgent report should carry the STORY, not just the Brent price — ceasefire status, Hormuz traffic, Red Sea shipping, OPEC. Split by driver so reason_discovery gets specific evidence. (The 5-min impact banner also covers these via rss_news.py TOPIC_FEEDS; this set is for the fuller report.)
